method: Finite enumeration of all 9^5 line strings, exact rational joint base scatter probabilities and beam masks, exact rational 50-state energy chain, linearity across 20 paylines and echo. No Monte Carlo enters the uncapped expectations.

capBounds.method: Exact single-line moments, convexity bound for correlated paylines, independent fresh boards and echo conditional on the exact capped energy Markov chain, polynomial stop-loss inequality. Every positive floating operation rounds outward.

serverReplay.method: Independent board, energy, beam and echo implementation and prefix scorer compared with real start/move after serializing each saved continuation. All 26 stakes and all 4 modes; natural 3/4/5-scatter branches forced independently of future seed draws.

cappedCoupling.proof: Sample latent independent future boards, beam attempts, energy and echo coins through the declared spin budget even after the actual engine would stop. Every awarded line amount is nonnegative. Sequential per-line capping and termination pay exactly min(latent uncapped complete-round payout, 10000 stakes). Skipping an echo draw or future spins after reaching the cap cannot alter this identity. Base payout is at most 800 stakes, so normal bonus suppression at the cap never occurs on its initial spin.

limitations: Uncapped expectation is exact rational arithmetic for the current model. Capped RTP is bounded using a conservative stop-loss moment inequality, rather than computed exactly.
The conservative lower bounds do not certify 95.8% minimum RTP. All upper bounds are below 100%, which excludes a positive mathematical expectation in these current modes.
All paylines share board cells. Marginal line enumeration suffices for expectation, but does not give the complete board or round distribution.
Integer settlement and normalized cap thresholds coincide at every current allowed stake.
Server replay covers current accepted initial states and free continuations, not adversarially forged persisted state or database wallet atomicity.
